snippet.title: Introducing Garden And A Goat!
snippet.description:
Here's a mini clip to celebrate the title announcement of our upcoming game. Wishlist on Steam and join our Discord today to stay connected and watch the game get made!

Wishlist on Steam at  https://gardenandagoat.com/steam
Come chat with us at https://gardenandagoat.com/discord
Links to everything else at https://gardenandagoat.com

#indiegame #cozygame #cozygamer #gamedev #goat
